featured_reviews.name: shruti ojha
featured_reviews.review_text: All I can say is you can trust them. I have always come across courier agents who stop answering calls once the package is out of India.When your loved ones send something, it’s more than just a box and Mahendra sir surely understands it very well. He called me and my father the day I was going to receive my parcel, due to some issues the parcel didn’t reach me. He helped me find numbers where I should be contacting and was taking updates continuously . In Milan this thing is very common because the delivery agents don’t struggle. This same thing happened with me last time but my old agent just left us with unanswered calls and messages. Because of which in a week my parcel was deported to Germany and I had to pay extra money to get it. Today they made second attempt and and I received my parcel!
